steps.title: Analyze and outline Simple Clicker 3D transition requirements
steps.description: Establish a full-screen, purely 3D interactive user interface by migrating all dashboard panels, control buttons, step-selection toggles, and statistics modules directly onto an immersive, dynamically shaded, real-time custom 3D Canvas view.

steps.title: Clean build configuration and remove external dependencies
steps.description: Remove the unused NanoHTTPD library from the gradle configurations, lock compiler target and compatibility settings to Java 8, and confirm SDK 34 standards.

steps.title: Construct fully 3D interactive viewport container
steps.description: Simplify the core layout to a single high-performance FrameLayout containing the full-screen interactive ThreeDCanvasView widget.

steps.title: Develop 3D spatial geometry definitions
steps.description: Define mathematical coordinates and index structures to render complex cuboid bodies alongside the custom dual-cone rotating gemstone in the virtual world.

steps.title: Implement multi-object 3D transformation matrices
steps.description: Code matrix transformations including scale, rotation, translation, and global perspective projections to map individual 3D objects to screen spaces.

steps.title: Formulate global Painter's Algorithm depth sorting
steps.description: Combine and sort every single polygon face from all distinct world objects in a unified descending order by average camera Z depth to prevent visual intersection clipping.

steps.title: Write real-time Flat Lambertian Shading and Wireframe outlines
steps.description: Calculate face surface normal vectors to estimate real-time diffuse illumination relative to a virtual directional light source, applying highlights on borders to emphasize geometric depth.

steps.title: Build dynamic 3D Perspective Text Overlay system
steps.description: Calculate text bounds and draw beautifully anti-aliased dashboard labels directly centered over projected 3D coordinates, resizing and tilting proportionally with Z depth.

steps.title: Implement individual Mass-Spring-Damper elasticity loops
steps.description: Program independent physics equations on all interactive 3D blocks to simulate realistic squishing, bouncing, and physical recoil on user contact.

steps.title: Program 3D raycast click hit-testing
steps.description: Develop 2D proximity raycast thresholds based on depth-scaled projection bounds to precisely identify which 3D virtual button is pressed.

steps.title: Add holistic drag tilt environment controllers
steps.description: Map raw vertical and horizontal drag events on the canvas background to adjust camera viewpoint rotation matrices, enabling an amazing holographic tilt perspective.

steps.title: Bind virtual callbacks to MainActivity data states
steps.description: Configure the UI callback listeners inside MainActivity to update shared preferences, tally milestones, and trigger haptic events upon receiving interactions from the 3D canvas.

steps.title: Perform manifest namespace and configuration validation
steps.description: Confirm appropriate namespace definitions, activity configurations, and orientation locks inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building Simple Clicker 3D
steps.description: Compile the entire 3D-only interactive platform through the default build sequence to ensure flawless compatibility.
